decisionPolicy.autoApprove: No critical fail, deterministic score >= 92, and warning count <= 2.
decisionPolicy.autoReject: Any critical gate fails, or deterministic score < 60.
decisionPolicy.humanIntervention: No critical fail, but deterministic score below auto-approval threshold or warnings need human judgement.
decisionPolicy.advisoryGuardrail: Zathura.AI can summarize, suggest remediation, and classify severity, but cannot override critical SOP gates. Final decision is anchored to deterministic SOP results.

checks.name: Vendor on Approved Master List
checks.description: Supplier must exist in the organization's approved vendor master for the invoice category.

checks.name: Vendor Compliance Status Active
checks.description: Vendor compliance status should be Active; review/probation requires procurement attention.

checks.name: Vendor Certification Validity
checks.description: Certifications must be valid through the delivery or service completion date.

checks.name: Vendor Tax Registration Valid
checks.description: GST/PAN/tax registration must be current and verified.

checks.name: Vendor Banking Details Verified
checks.description: Vendor bank account must be verified before payment release.

checks.name: Denied-Party / Sanctions Screening
checks.description: No sanctions, embargo, or denied-party screening match is allowed.

checks.name: Insurance & Liability Coverage
checks.description: Current insurance must be on file for risk-bearing categories.

checks.name: Invoice Within Approved Budget
checks.description: Invoice total must not exceed the approved department budget beyond tolerance.

checks.name: Price Variance vs Market Benchmark
checks.description: Unit price variance should stay within +/-15% of benchmark or historical quotation.

checks.name: Minimum Competitive Quotations Obtained
checks.description: At least three compliant quotations are expected above the micro-purchase threshold.

checks.name: Lowest-Cost Vendor Selected / Justified
checks.description: If the lowest quote is not selected, justification must be documented.

checks.name: Cost Center Has Sufficient Budget Balance
checks.description: The department cost center must have sufficient balance.

checks.name: Payment Terms Within Company Policy
checks.description: Payment terms should be within Net 30 to Net 90 unless approved.

checks.name: Delegation of Authority Matches Invoice Value
checks.description: Requester authority level must be sufficient for the total invoice value.

checks.name: No Duplicate Invoice or Request
checks.description: No duplicate invoice number or similar department request in the last 30 days.

checks.name: Master Agreement / Contract on File
checks.description: An active agreement should exist for recurring vendor-category spend.

checks.name: Delivery Timeline Meets Required-By Date
checks.description: Vendor delivery or service date should meet the business required-by date.

checks.name: Category Matches Department Procurement Scope
checks.description: The requested category should belong to the department's approved procurement scope.

checks.name: No Conflict of Interest Flagged
checks.description: No COI relationship may exist between vendor and organization stakeholders.

checks.name: Regulatory / QA Sign-Off for Controlled Categories
checks.description: Controlled raw materials, API, and regulated lab inputs need QA/regulatory sign-off.

checks.name: Cross-Border Currency & Incoterms Validity
checks.description: International invoices need currency, tax, and Incoterms validation.

checks.name: ESG / Sustainability Threshold
checks.description: Vendor ESG score should meet the minimum threshold of 60.

checks.name: Vendor Historical Performance
checks.description: Vendor on-time delivery and quality performance should meet thresholds.

checks.name: Three-Way Match Data Consistency
checks.description: PO, GRN/service confirmation, and invoice should match quantity, price, tax, and vendor.

checks.name: Required Documentation Complete
checks.description: Invoice, quotation, business justification, and supporting documents must be complete.
